description: This Java source file defines the class `ThingQueryResponseSignalMapper`, which is responsible for mapping signals related to 'Thing Query Responses' in the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It extends an abstract class and implements an interface to handle validation, topic path building, and payload enhancement for specific command responses.

classes.name: ThingQueryResponseSignalMapper
classes.description: A signal mapper class that handles validation and payload modification for 'ThingQueryCommandResponse' signals. It extends 'AbstractQuerySignalMapper' and implements 'ResponseSignalMapper'.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the command response's class name ends with 'Response'; throws an exception if not.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Constructs a TopicPathBuilder for the specific thing entity based on the command.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Enhances the payload builder with status and entity data from the command response.
